accountant.name: Accountant
accountant.sticker: ★ Our take: YES — With a license. The license is a ticket into the arena, not a shield: inside, trust and niche win. As a typist — no.
money: ~$84K median — licensed accountants (BLS, 2025); top 10% over $144,090.
Training: 3–5 years · CPA route — or 6–12 months as an Enrolled Agent (tax only, no degree).
AI risk: medium — the roadmap shows what AI took and what stayed human.
